📊 MARKET UPDATE: GOLD / XAUUSD 📊

Gold is currently price around 4140, with price holding above the H1 BO zone around 4135 to 4140. The short term structure is showing some recovery after the strong drop, so buyers may try to push price higher as long as this zone continues to hold.

If price stays above the H1 BO zone, the next important target is the H1 resistance around 4158 to 4165. A strong break above this resistance could open the way for further upside toward the H4 BO around 4240.

If price gets rejected from the H1 resistance or breaks below the H1 BO zone, selling pressure could return. The main downside area to watch is the H4 support around 4115 to 4120, followed by the Daily BO around 4100.📱 @nursejannah
